audit.why: Unraveled Earth (E, flat 14s, 950 range) stuns enemies that dash through it or are knocked through it. Akshan's Heroic Swing crossing that minefield stuns him mid-swing, and Seismic Shove (W, 14s at rank 1, 900 range) exists to knock him into it. Conversely Weaver's Wall creates terrain, which is a free grapple anchor for Heroic Swing — Akshan can swing off the wall she built.
